verdict.rationale: Vanta's marketing says it lets you "track progress all in one place" per framework and gives "continuous, complete visibility" across the program. It also flags gaps, runs pass/fail automated tests, and tracks compliance status per framework control. However, no evidence describes a per-framework readiness view that rolls passing controls and open gaps into a single percentage. Missing for 10: a documented per-framework readiness dashboard, an explicit percentage or score showing distance from audit-ready, a breakdown of passing versus remaining controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
